newsitem.title: NORWAY: Palestinian President Arafat arrives in Norway.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian President Arafat arrives in Norway.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Norway on Monday on a trip criticised by the United States as likely to hamper mediation after Israel and the PLO again failed to agree on partial Israeli withdrawal from Hebron.
Arafat's plane landed at Oslo's Fornebu airport shortly after 2 p.m. (1300gmt), reporters on the tarmac said.

Arafat, speaking to reporters at the airport, rejected Israeli accusations he was stalling after Palestinians and Israel failed on Sunday to agree on a partial Israeli withdrawal from the West Bank town.
"It is going on. The subcomittees are going on," he said, referring to the peace process.

In Israel, U.S. Middle East envoy Dennis Ross said he was heading home, having failed in another all-night effort to get Israeli and Palestinian negotiators to agree. Ross said Arafat's European trip would hamper mediation efforts.
Palestinians have said Israel is trying to renegotiate terms of the Hebron withdrawal which the Jewish state agreed to more than a year ago.
